name: token-saver
description: Run checks, compact output and locate repository content with bounded evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Run checks and compact their output with recoverable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Development plugin with an existing-check runner, captured-output compaction, precise repository lookup and a versioned result contract. Other helpers remain planned.
defaultPrompt: Run an agreed check and retain its complete output.
Compact an existing log and retain its diagnostics.
Locate files or text in an existing repository.
